standing_rules: Target roles are Software Engineer / AI Engineer tracks ONLY. Never target, scrape for, rank, or tailor toward IT Support, Help Desk, SOC, Security Analyst, or Networking/SysAdmin roles.
No work authorization, visa, immigration, or sponsorship language anywhere, on any document, regardless of how a job posting is worded.
No mention of Farmside Technologies or any India-based work experience, in any document, regardless of how a job posting is worded.
KwikJobs metrics are locked at 10,000+ users / 1,000+ businesses. Never round up, extrapolate, or add unverified numbers.
Never list a certification as earned unless it is in certifications_earned. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner is in progress - never include it in any form, not even as 'in progress' or 'pursuing'.

Never invent a metric, percentage, benchmark result, dataset size, accuracy/F1, or outcome. If a bullet would be stronger with a number not provided here, flag it as needed input rather than estimating.
Never phrase anything so it implies experience Shiva cannot defend unscripted under a technical interviewer's follow-up. Coursework stays coursework, a project stays a project.
No AI-sounding copy. Banned: spearheaded, leveraged, results-driven, dynamic, passionate about, delve, robust, cutting-edge, decorative em-dashes, three-verb lists.
No founder-bragging tone on KwikJobs or HypeSquad. Describe what was built and its real scale.
